name: far upstream element binding protein 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FUBP1 encodes far upstream element-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include mRNA 3'-UTR binding and single-stranded DNA binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of gene expression.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
